name: DESI instrument (corrector, focal plane, fibre system and spectrographs)
notes: No detector-level specs are recorded beyond the experiment key specs; the telescope itself (Mayall 4-m) belongs to Kitt Peak.

placements.note: Installation spanned 2018 to 2019 (table of milestones: corrector installed 11/30/18, focal plate assembly installed 7/24/19); no single installation date is given, so start is left open.
placements.quote: This instrumentation is installed at the 4 m Nicholas U. Mayall telescope at Kitt Peak National Observatory

summary.plain: The fibre-fed spectroscopic machine mounted on the Mayall telescope: a wide-field lens corrector, 5,020 robotic fibre positioners and ten spectrographs.
summary.technical: DESI prime-focus system on the 4-m Mayall telescope: 3.2-deg diameter corrector, 5020 robotic fibre positioners on a 0.812 m focal surface, ten spectrographs covering 360–980 nm at resolution 2000–5000.

technology.quote: The ten spectrographs each use a pair of dichroics to split the light into three channels that together record the light from 360 - 980 nm with a resolution of 2000 to 5000.
technology.value: Prime-focus multi-object fibre spectroscopic system: 5020 robotic fibre positioners feeding ten spectrographs that record 360–980 nm at resolution 2000 to 5000.
